address: Plaza de la Libertad 9, Burgos, 09004, Spain
bio: Cobo Tradición is located in the medieval heart of the city, just a few metres from the emblematic 15C Casa del Cordón. Here, as part of a complex called Cobo Estratos, you’ll find an interior with an avant-garde design where the striking staircase and kitchens (also home to the award-winning Cobo Evolución) are the two standout features. The à la carte of traditional dishes has been brought impressively up to date and includes classics such as grilled and fried “morcilla de Burgos” (black pudding) with roasted peppers and sea salt, and the superb braised scallops with herb oil and Iberian pork cheek....
